features.title: Schema v3: rules_manifest, rule_paths, walkthrough_path, rules_applied + validate-artifacts-check

validate-artifacts.sh: rules_manifest check — hashes each manifest entry against disk; fails with named error (missing / hash mismatch) when manifest is non-empty array; silent no-op when absent/null

record-feature.sh changes — none needed; handoff already stored integrally (verified, documented)

features.title: Serial runner: leeslijst pinnen, rules_applied afdwingen, walkthrough, rule-kandidaten

implemented: Step 2.3: coder spawn prompt pins design budget (from mission.md) and rule_paths as mandatory binding reading list; backward compatible when rule_paths absent/empty
Step 2.4: handoff without non-empty rules_applied when rule_paths non-empty counts as failed attempt under existing attempt/cap rules

Step 2.5: orchestrator compiles handoffs/<milestone-id>-walkthrough.md per REFERENCE.md template after every milestone validation; sets milestones[].walkthrough_path via atomic jq write; advisories never influence validation_status
Step 3: final report includes rule-kandidaten distilled from issues_discovered and lessons; runner never mutates .claude/rules/
Frontmatter allowed-tools: Write toegevoegd
issues_discovered: Walkthrough jq-snippet gebruikt placeholder-namen — bewust, operating manual-conventie
rules_applied-afdwinging als orchestrator-check in stap 2.4; record-feature.sh niet gewijzigd conform design budget

features.title: Parallel runner: pinning en walkthrough gespiegeld (stap 3.4 + 3.7)

implemented: Frontmatter: Write toegevoegd aan allowed-tools
Stap 3.4: design budget (verbatim uit mission.md) + rule_paths als verplichte leeslijst gepind per coder-slot; backward compatible bij absent/leeg rule_paths
Stap 3.5: rules_applied-afdwinging vóór de integrate-feature aanroep — ontbrekend veld bij non-lege rule_paths telt als mislukte poging of blocked (zelfde logica als serial 2.4)
